inputs.temperature_status: IMPORTED/EMPIRICAL FIRAS-fixed observer-side datum; not an independent CMB prediction

D/H_quasar_absorption.observer_measures: two Voigt-profile column densities N(DI) and N(HI) along one line of sight
D/H_quasar_absorption.derived_statement: If N_D,obs = J_1D N_D,bare and N_H,obs = J_1D N_H,bare, then (D/H)_obs = (D/H)_bare.
D/H_quasar_absorption.what_would_have_to_break: a species-dependent readout acting differently on DI and HI profile inference, not a common LOS Jacobian

Yp_HII_emission.produced_quantity: primordial helium number fraction converted to mass fraction
Yp_HII_emission.observer_measures: He and H emission line fluxes from an ionized nebular volume
Yp_HII_emission.derived_statement: Common volume and luminosity-distance factors cancel in same-source line ratios before the He->mass conversion.
Yp_HII_emission.what_would_have_to_break: species-dependent emissivity readout beyond the current stack

Li7_stellar_photosphere.produced_quantity: primordial number ratio n_Li / n_H after stellar archaeology assumptions
Li7_stellar_photosphere.observer_measures: Li I 6708 Å equivalent width relative to the stellar continuum
Li7_stellar_photosphere.derived_statement: A common surface-brightness factor cancels in line-to-continuum equivalent-width inference.
Li7_stellar_photosphere.what_would_have_to_break: a species-dependent boundary correction in line formation or stellar-atmosphere inversion

verdict.summary: The different observational pipelines are genuinely 1D, 2D, and 3D in a descriptive sense, but the relevant abundance observables are dimensionless ratios built from same-channel data, so the leading geometric Jacobian cancels in all three. The D/H and Li tensions are therefore not resolved by simple measurement-chain geometry on the current stack.
verdict.temperature_statement: Running exact BBN at T_obs instead of T_IO shifts the abundances materially, so the thermodynamic T_IO choice does matter for BBN; the report quantifies the size.
